rulings.decision: Dedicated branch in the existing checkout, no implicit worktree
rulings.why: No worktree was requested; host instructions prohibit creating one implicitly
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Shared filesystem requires avoiding concurrent writers

rulings.why: It uses State.Apply but has no normal-history or OnResults forwarding
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An overlooked downstream consumer could still publish rejected data

rulings.decision: No trusted timestamp means no numeric observation in the public DTO
rulings.why: signal.Value's zero value is a legitimate numeric zero, not absence
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Consumers ignoring quality/time could still mistake an internal zero for a reading

rulings.decision: Do not invent provenance for undeclared producers
rulings.why: Only the existing Modbus success path can explicitly declare platform_collection here
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Other adapters need their own provenance work before claiming this contract

rulings.decision: Share query lifecycle and presentation, and key by device plus point
rulings.why: The browser reproduction exposed parent-health inference and cross-station rows
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A differently identified adapter needs an explicit identity mapping, not a guessed fallback

rulings.decision: Expose server evaluation/expiry bounds and use monotonic request elapsed time in the UI
rulings.why: An outstanding query must not freeze an old normal label; the browser must not invent sensor TTLs
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Slow transport can conservatively mark data expired earlier, not later

rulings.decision: Do not infer physical clock-reset epochs from indistinguishable old packets
rulings.why: Without independent ordering evidence an old packet could simply be delayed; it must not refresh current state
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An actual device clock reset may remain unusable until trustworthy time is restored; automatic epoch-reset recovery is not claimed

review.method: Two independent fresh-context read-only reviews, Standards and Spec. One coordinator fix pass; no second review claimed.

fixed: Read completion timestamp, not cycle start
Retained values in command dialogs no longer called current; quality and source time shown
Cancelled/obsolete channel results cannot overwrite the replacement channel's state
Saving verification metadata preserves station-scoped points
minor_deferred: Older discarded samples have no independent rejection diagnostic; they still cannot replace or refresh accepted data

fix_verification: TestCancelledRunnerDoesNotPublishCompletedRead: RED with one obsolete cycle, GREEN with cancellation suppression; Service additionally serializes active-source identity checks with state mutation.

TestSuccessfulBlockUsesReadCompletionTime: RED with source time before the read completed, GREEN with per-block clock capture. RunOnce and legacy Engine.Cycle now consume a clock function; production uses time.Now, deterministic tests retain fixed clocks.
Actual UI save: RED changed station 1 from three points to four including station 2; GREEN retained exactly three station-1 points after the successful PUT.

Actual UI command preview: RED showed '当前 120' with no quality; GREEN preview and confirmation showed recent observation 120, failed quality and original source time. An injected HTTP 503 also changed the confirmation from normal to query-failed. No command was submitted.
Post-fix full Go suite, observation/navigation/consistency checks and TypeScript/Vite build all exited 0.
declined_to_judge_rulings: Standards deferred spec completeness to the independent Spec axis; it was reviewed there.
Formatting/types are checked by gofmt, diff checks and tsc rather than a second manual style verdict.

Real hardware/RTU, other adapters, device replacement/clock epoch recovery, history backfill and platform-wide timers remain explicitly outside this ticket; cost: this evidence cannot certify those paths.
Legacy Engine.Cycle has no normal-history/publication chain; it was nevertheless adapted in the fix pass so actual collection and receipt clocks stay coherent.

final_rulings.decision: Adapt the RunOnce/Engine.Cycle clock seam during the review fix, superseding the earlier leave-legacy-unchanged ruling
final_rulings.why: A fixed cycle-start value cannot timestamp each completed read correctly; sampling and receipt must use the same clock domain
final_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Out-of-tree internal test harnesses using these Go methods must pass a clock function; no external HTTP contract was removed

final_rulings.decision: Keep external result callbacks outside the Service registry mutex
final_rulings.why: Ownership checks and state updates must be atomic with channel replacement, but callbacks may re-enter the service
final_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Callbacks for already-accepted observations can finish after removal; preserved source timestamps still govern published values

final_rulings.decision: Run Task 3's embedded final review before its completion ledger entry
final_rulings.why: The task brief includes review and cleanup, so it must not be marked complete beforehand
final_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Ordering differs from the generic workflow diagram, but no verification gate is omitted
